reason: The plugin provides a /init command that analyzes a project and generates an AGENTS.md guide, with optional filesystem writes, Git initialization, external template download, and initial commit operations.

summaries.zh: 通过 /init 分析当前项目并生成或更新 AGENTS.md 指南，支持可选的 Git 初始化、模板下载和初始提交。
summaries.en: Adds an /init command that analyzes the current project and generates or updates an AGENTS.md guide, with optional Git initialization, template download, and initial commit actions.

capabilities: Analyzes a project's directory structure and infers its language, framework, and build tools using a model
Generates and writes or replaces an AGENTS.md project guide
Can initialize a Git repository, rename the default branch, download a matching .gitignore template, and create an initial commit when explicitly requested
Sends project structure and prompts to a configured model service
